lines.text: Queen Amina of Zazzau was a warrior queen. But how much of her story is real?
Zazzau was a Hausa kingdom, around today's Zaria, in northern Nigeria.
Tradition says Amina led her own soldiers into battle, and grew the kingdom's lands.
Earthen walls around many Hausa towns are still called Ganuwar Amina: Amina's walls.
The oldest written account, the Kano Chronicle, was written down centuries later. It says she conquered towns as far as Nupe and Kwararafa.
So historians still debate her dates and details. But her legend lives on, from Zaria to a statue in Lagos.
